Description: Heavy supply ($64B+) and fast-flipping from retail/hedge funds creates absorption fatigue. Underwriter syndicate steps in near $76 to defend offer.
Unallocated institutional demand (6/7ths unsatisfied) absorbs early retail supply. Follows Alibaba/Arm trajectory of steady institutional bid.
Sovereign wealth funds, global tech ETFs, and retail frenzy trigger a massive uncrossing imbalance. Scarcity premium drives aggressive price discovery.
